knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Strength comes from the label and manufacturer's directions. Smell and colour are not reliable measures.
The dilution control system mixes the product and water during filling. The other two methods are made up by hand or with a measure.
An unknown or unlabelled bottle is not used. It is checked and relabelled or discarded under site policy.

practicalCriteria: Fills a bottle with one of the three methods, using the dilution given on the product label.
Labels the bottle with product, dilution and date, and fits and tests the trigger.
Identifies an unlabelled bottle and removes it from use.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% pass mark, which for three questions means all three correct. Practical sign-off is separate and observed by an assessor.
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of one bottle fill
Labelled bottle inspected by the assessor
stopWorkCriteria: Bottle made up without reading the label dilution
